description: Enhanced technical-string masking cases: prose with no technical strings (all words kept), multiple hex color codes on one line, two URLs (http and https) on one line, a line consisting entirely of a URL (empty result), and a URL at the very end with a preceding ordinary word. Each surviving word is reported as its UTF-8 start byte offset, end byte offset, and text, one per line, ordered by position. The request is {"op":"skip","text":<text>}.

input.text: no technical strings here at all

cases.expected_output:
0 2 no
3 12 technical
13 20 strings
21 25 here
26 28 at
29 32 all

input.text: two urls http://a.com/x and https://b.org/y end
